task: Rewrite the W2-92 README map's unmatched test items into a form `gov accept` matches, without changing any line's tests or expectations.
status: DONE. Every map item now matches a collected case, and `gov accept DAEO-n0wb` gives "pass" on all 7 KPI lines (exit 0).
work_completed: I rewrote the 8 unmatched items as full function names without the parameter list. Each parameter id stays next to its name in plain text, e.g. "(cases: plain, batched, …)", outside the backticks, so the runner does not read it as an item. The two bare `test_c3`/`test_c4` and the `test_c3_...` became full names. No item, test or line was added or removed, no red reason was changed, and no test file was touched.

Items before → after: success-1 `test_r1_…_reaches_the_bundle[decision id, contract id, ticket id, W2 id, record title]` → `test_r1_a_record_named_in_a_plain_question_reaches_the_bundle` (cases: …); success-2 `test_c3_...` → `test_c3_a_question_naming_both_a_record_and_a_symbol_takes_both_routes`; failure-2 `test_c3` → that same full name, `test_c4` → `test_c4_the_command_takes_the_code_route_of_a_plain_question`, and `test_c5_…[unknown, none]` → `test_c5_a_question_naming_no_symbol_of_the_index_sends_no_whole_graph_query` (cases: unknown, none); success-3/failure-3 `test_f1_…[never indexed, tool cannot read it, tool not on PATH]` → `test_f1_a_code_index_that_cannot_answer_is_named_and_the_rest_is_returned` (cases: …); success-4/failure-1 `test_u1_…[plain, batched, unknown id, unknown symbol, ticket]` → `test_u1_a_question_naming_no_record_or_symbol_gets_todays_bundle` (cases: …), and `test_u3_…[new routes, plain]` → `test_u3_two_runs_on_one_store_give_the_same_bundle` (cases: …). Checker output: "cases: 30; success-1 6 items; success-2 4; failure-2 5; success-3 5; failure-3 5; success-4 5; failure-1 5", with no MISSING line. The item counts per line are the same as before.
tests: `gov accept DAEO-n0wb --json` gives outcome "pass", exit 0, totals 30 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped, unmapped 0/0/0. Per line (passed/failed/skipped): success-1 pass 9/0/0, success-2 pass 7/0/0, success-3 pass 6/0/0, success-4 pass 9/0/0, failure-1 pass 9/0/0, failure-2 pass 6/0/0, failure-3 pass 6/0/0. `pytest tests --collect-only`: 19103/19105 collected (2 deselected), no collection error.
discoveries: Items that name only a file (`test_w2_92_record_route.py`, `test_w2_92_code_route.py`, …) map every case in that file to the line. That is why success-1 counts 9 (all 8 record-route cases plus c3) and success-2 counts 7 (the whole code-route file, including c0, c2 and c5). This was already so before my change, and I left it as it was.
risks: The per-line counts are wider than the named tests because of those file items. A later failure in, say, c5 would also fail success-2. That is the map as written, not something I changed.
lessons: The runner matches a bare item only when it is the exact function name, and an item with `[` only when it is one exact pytest id. Parameter lists must stay outside backticks.
